header: Full-width rows with room for a paragraph
lead: Each row has an icon and a whole paragraph, with a rule between rows: for when a grid cell is too small for the argument. The three rows below are true of this theme.

items.title: Twenty-five themes, one set of markup
items.text: A theme is a set of tokens. Switching it changes colour, type and corner radius on every element, and no template is touched.

items.title: Contrast checked in all fifty palettes
items.text: Twenty-five themes in light and dark make fifty palettes. A build script measures every text and control colour in them against WCAG 2.2 AA.

items.title: Native HTML before script
items.text: Disclosures are details elements, dialogs are dialog elements and rails use scroll snap. One small script adds what HTML has no element for: tabs, carousel buttons and search suggestions.
